title: Capture why across session handoffs
narrative: Handoffs preserve completed/pending work, decisions, rationale, rejected alternatives, risks, and next action — hosts store the record. Accepts WalkingLabs L05 guidance[^wl-l05-handoff]. Maps to personal-agent MH-PA-04[^insp-pa-04]: evidence and risks are first-class; goals, exclusions, and verdict schema still travel via open detail until extended. Also the typed handoff seam for Dots MH-DOTS-07[^insp-dots-07-handoff].
implementation: `HandoffRecord` in `mechaharness.handoff_record` is the reusable schema; storage remains host-owned. Personal-agent MH-PA-04: `evidence_refs` and `risks` are first-class; goals, exclusions, and expected verdict remain host `detail` until schema promotion.

footnotes.label: Personal agent reliability (MH-PA-04)
footnotes.note: Delegation and handoff; goals/exclusions/verdict still via detail
